# CertPath — Modern Tech Certification Learning Platform

> CertPath (https://certpath.dev) is an interactive, developer-first learning platform for mastering AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco CCNA, CompTIA, and Kubernetes CKA/CKAD certifications through bite-sized lessons, active recall flashcards, and timed mock exams.

## Certification Tracks

- [AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)](https://certpath.dev/certifications/aws/cloud-practitioner): 20 Lessons covering Cloud Concepts, AWS Global Infrastructure, IAM Security, EC2, S3 Storage Classes, VPC Networking, RDS/Aurora Databases, Well-Architected Framework, and AWS Support.
- [Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)](https://certpath.dev/certifications/azure/az-900): 20 Lessons covering Cloud Computing, Azure Regions/AZs, Virtual Machines, Blob Tiers & Redundancy (LRS/ZRS/GRS), Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Policy, Defender for Cloud, and SLAs.
- [Google Cloud Digital Leader (CDL)](https://certpath.dev/certifications/google/cloud-fundamentals): 20 Lessons covering 4-Level Resource Hierarchy, Compute Engine, App Engine, Cloud Storage Tiers, Cloud SQL/Spanner, Cloud IAM, Cloud Operations, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, and Security Command Center.
- [Kubernetes Fundamentals & CKA/CKAD](https://certpath.dev/certifications/kubernetes/fundamentals): 16 Lessons covering Container Runtimes, Control Plane/Worker Nodes, Pods, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicies, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Persistent Storage (PV/PVC), HPA Scaling, RBAC, Helm, and Cluster Diagnostics.
- [Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA 200-301)](https://certpath.dev/certifications/cisco/networking): 16 Lessons covering OSI & TCP/IP models, IPv4/IPv6 VLSM subnetting, Ethernet Switching, VLANs, OSPF dynamic routing, Extended ACLs, NAT/PAT, Switch Security, Wireless WLC, and SDN Automation.
- [CompTIA IT Fundamentals (ITF+) & A+](https://certpath.dev/certifications/comptia/fundamentals): 16 Lessons covering Binary/Hex data units, Motherboards/CPU/RAM, NVMe & RAID, Power Supplies & USB-C/Thunderbolt, OS & CLI administration (ipconfig, sfc, tracert, chmod), Wi-Fi 6, Cybersecurity MFA, SQL databases, and 6-step Troubleshooting.

## Interactive Learning Features

- 108 Curated Lessons with theory, architectural diagrams, and real-world examples.
- Interactive Knowledge Checks with immediate answer verification and in-depth explanations.
- Spaced Repetition Flashcards for active recall.
- Interactive Scenario Labs (IAM Policy Simulator, Subnet Partitioner, YAML Manifest Validator).
- Timed Mock Exams simulating authentic exam question distribution and passing thresholds.
